verdict.rationale: Evidence covers fleet management of individual readers, receipts, tipping, refunds, and payouts, but nothing describes a bulk/batch API or dashboard action for operating on many items (e.g., many payments, refunds, or readers) in a single call. Missing for 10: any bulk-create/bulk-update/batch endpoint, evidence of processing multiple transactions or readers in one request, or documentation of a batch API for Terminal.
